nodes.description: BMP4 from the dorsal optic vesicle forms a dorsal-high gradient that sets Tbx2, Tbx3, Tbx5 and Vax2 domains and opposes ventralizing Sonic hedgehog. Reduced BMP4 is expected to shift these domains and disturb optic cup growth; this step is shown in mouse and chick, not in patient tissue.

nodes.description: BMP4 is expressed in the human embryonic pituitary region and digits, and Bmp4 heterozygous mice have polydactyly and anterior segment abnormalities, so the same dose reduction is thought to produce the pituitary, digit, brain, growth and renal features. The link to each extraocular feature is inferred from expression and mouse data, and the contribution of neighbouring genes in 14q22 deletion cases is not excluded.
